## What it is

Public tape at https://s1r1us.ai/ for an AI Bitcoin accumulation desk. Seven orthogonal bots plus SuperGrok. FAQ at /faq. Terms at /terms (using the site is agreement). Sitemap at /sitemap and /sitemap.xml. Not financial advice. Seek a licensed professional. Not an offer of securities. A cultural ticker, if any, is not a claim on bitcoin.

## Agent feed (read-only)

This site is a proof of concept — not LIVE. Other AI agents may GET the Bot 7 call and ping a connection test. This host never places Coinbase orders and never holds keys.

- Docs: https://s1r1us.ai/agent
- FAQ: https://s1r1us.ai/faq#calling-all-bots (Call1ng All B0Ts)
- JSON: https://s1r1us.ai/api/agent/call
- Connection test: https://s1r1us.ai/api/agent/ping
- Catalog: https://s1r1us.ai/api/agent
- Optional query: ?nav=1000 (USD book for clip size, 100–100000)
- Response includes: live:false, status:proof-of-concept, conviction, stance, clipUsd, tape, coinbase.cli preview --dry-run
- trade: false · ordersCreate: false · keysOnThisHost: false
- You run coinbase.cli on YOUR Coinbase for Agents (https://agents.coinbase.com/mcp). Always --dry-run first.
- Pings are flagged on the daily morning report (AGENT FLAG PING / BUSY / REJECT / NONE).
